summary: The note describes Thadoona Land District, a cadastral division of Western Australia. It is a subdivision of the North-West Land Division and lies in the Mid West region of the state.
one_line: Thadoona Land District is a cadastral land district in Western Australia's Mid West region, part of the North-West Land Division.
key_facts: Thadoona Land District is a land district (cadastral division) of Western Australia.
Thadoona Land District is a subdivision of the North-West Land Division.
Thadoona Land District is located in the Mid West region of Western Australia.
